svg.aria-label: Argo CD Agent via the ACM GitOps add-on: the hub Argo CD runs as principal with its controller disabled. The GitOpsCluster creates certificates, agent-mode cluster secrets and ManifestWorks; the gitops-addon on the managed cluster installs OpenShift GitOps and the agent. The agent opens a gRPC connection with mutual TLS to the principal, receives the Applications routed by destination name, reconciles them locally and sends the full status back, so the hub UI shows the complete resource tree
